1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Present application has been preferred with the prayer to quash the charge-sheet dated 2 2 . 0 6 . 2 0 0 6 a r i s i n g o u t o f c a s e c r i m e n o .

Further it is also prayed that the proceedings of the criminal case no. 2845/06 (State of U.P vs. Gaffar Khan and others) under Sections 420/239/423/424/467/468/474/482/120-B/504/506 IPC, P.S. sentences.text: 3. At the very outset, learned counsel for applicants submitted that no offence under Section 420/239/423/424/467/468/474/482/120-B/504/506 IPC is made out against the applicants.
The aforesaid case has been registered against the applicants with malafide and malicious intention and only to harass the applicants.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party although vehemently opposed the prayer sought through the instant application but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

5. By bare perusal of the records, it is crystal clear that matter is pending before this Court since 2008 itself and nothing fruitful has been came up just over the interim protection which was granted in favour of the applicants by the Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 28.8.2008.
6.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the concerned trial court is hereby directed to expedite and finalize the proceedings of the aforesaid case as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of 12 months from the date of presentation of a certified copy of this order before him without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.

7. Learned counsel for applicants assures on the behalf of the applicants that applicants will fully cooperate with the learned trial court concerned for expeditious disposal of the criminal case no.
2845/06 (State of U.P vs. Gaffar Khan and others).
8.
However, it is made clear that till the disposal of the proceedings of the aforementioned criminal case, no coercive action shall be taken up against the applicants herein.
9. The instant application U/S 482 stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Shaswat  Gaffar Khan And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151801701/
